crowdsourced_ai_results.analysis: The analyzed binary is a legitimate Microsoft SQL Server component, specifically the SQL Full-Text Filter Daemon Launcher (fdlauncher.exe). It is responsible for managing the full-text search host processes (fdhost.exe). Key behaviors identified in the decompilation include service initialization (ServiceMain), named pipe communication for process control, and registry-based configuration lookup under 'Software\Microsoft\Microsoft SQL Server\170'. A significant security feature observed is the use of WinVerifyTrust to validate the digital signature of 'fdhost.exe' before it is executed via CreateProcessW. The inclusion of cross-platform configuration paths (mssql.conf) and standard logging routines is consistent with legitimate SQL Server 2017+ infrastructure.
